items.text: While our whole feed is buzzing about Ocean Keeper: Co-op, our devs have been quietly locked in their office room… (totally voluntary, we swear!)

Inside that little room they’ve been flipping through the tenth volume of “The Complete Fish Encyclopedia” and moving UI buttons around the screen trying to find the perfect spot (totally not a joke…)
All that hard work brings you something fresh and shiny – a brand-new and longawaited update for Ocean Keeper: Dome Survival!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/0b25db98c7636d0a62b6e62afe71021a73a78e3d.jpg"]
So let’s not pull the squid by its tentacles, here’s what’s new in the Deep Tides update!
You can finally track your current objective directly in the HUD, no more wandering around wondering, “Wait, what was I supposed to do again?”
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/8cbb8a50bf850d5300c9e3523b16fd0c69cb5ed9.png"]
We also added a mission token that points toward the mine you need to visit. Consider it your personal underwater GPS (without the annoying voice)
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/e735cf2d72fd264ebca940103021fb1a3f2d81f7.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/471529e7749820adc59e364348f37425b617bd3b.png"]

You’ll also notice a new low-health indicator and a cool Mech repair effect. It’s our subtle way of saying: “Hey, you might wanna fix that before you explode” Oh, and we moved the Repair button closer to your abilities.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/9cbdf4193d24a4e5e64aaa95b41acdf91f6e1315.png"]
For all dialogue enjoyers out there: you can now manually skip lines! Auto-skip is off, delay between skips is minimal, but yes. Mech still talks too much. We love him.
We also gave relic upgrade cards a little visual pop, they look as fancy as the treasures they represent.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/e7f6b5177f6629df81d9a3f3f7ce83d98a57d3c7.jpg"]
And oh, we’ve added Hungarian localization!
The tutorial just got a quality-of-life changes!
We added a new step explaining Mech repair mechanics (because, apparently, just throwing duct tape at the player wasn’t enough).
The Hub interface is now fully unlocked, so you can browse all upgrades right from the start.
Plus, we sprinkled in a few micro UX tweaks to make your first dive smoother than a dolphin’s backflip.
We’ve added new ability for your Digger!
X-Ray – see through walls, grab more ores.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/6d4a4f74155965adb5ba065b3209ff306e9787c8.gif"]
Also, we reduced the number of sessions needed to get a new task from the Collector (he finally learned how to multitask)
We’ve rebalanced waves, improved enemy variety and adjusted difficulty progression so you’ll face less hardcore… well, slightly less.
Meet the newest troublemaker of the Ocean Keeper ecosystem: the Aura Worm – a cute (not really) mini-tank that buffs enemies around it. You’ll hate it. >:3
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/d767f9c0975f545b6af5cfab126341a536226a3d.gif"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/0cbd982d006a2386f62e4aeda98da72e6cad02e2.png"]
We tuned meta-upgrades, making them cheaper for a smoother start
Beating a boss now means extra upgrade picks. Treat yourself.
Ah yes, everyone’s favorite section, where we pretend those bugs never existed.
Titanic Softlock (aka “Box vs. Door Saga”)
If you placed a box near the door, hit the button, and somehow trapped yourself forever – congratulations, you discovered a feature. Well, it was a feature. Now it’s fixed.
Blocked Mines
Some mines decided to generate unbreakable blocks and block progress. We told them to chill. They now behave like proper mines again.
Laser Digger Visual Bug
That mysterious gray square following your laser? Gone. It had a good run, but it’s time to say goodbye, Squarey.
Story Mech Light
The flashing light that could blind a whale has been toned down. You can safely look at your Mech again.
Rays From the Sky
The heavens have returned! Missing light rays are back where they belong, dramatically shining through the depths once more.
Gamepad UI
Added the missing “(X)” icon to the Buy button in the Customization > Upgrades tab. Both Digger and Mech now officially recognize your inputs.
Xbox Login on Steam
Some players got an unexpected Xbox login popup when launching the Steam build. The console gods have been appeased – it won’t appear again.
Graphics Settings
Your graphics settings will now actually save. No more eternal “Low graphics” life.
Reports Window
It finally opens! And doesn’t immediately throw an error at you. Small miracles.
Localization Fixes
Fixed overflowing text in several places. Letters now stay inside the boxes.
That’s the Deep Tides Update. Now it’s your turn: dive in, test the waters and tell us what you think!
And one more thing before we swim off...
Ocean Keeper: Co-op is heading to Early Access at the end of November!
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3937360/Ocean_Keeper_Coop_Drill_Multiplayer/"]So keep your sonar tuned and wishlist the game ;)
See you, Guardians!
– The Ocean Keeper Team
Check out our very-very serious video about Deep Tides Update on YT!
We’ve just released Hotfix 1.0.2 for Ocean Keeper is now available on Steam. This update focuses on important bug fixes to improve your gameplay experience.
Resolved an issue in the Titanic where a box could get stuck if taken the wrong way down the aisle.
Fixed an animation freeze for the digger when hitting a block with the glove just before the bomb exploded.
Addressed a bug where enemies would stop chasing the mech beyond a certain distance.

We’re actively reading all your feedback on Steam and Discord. Your reports and suggestions help us prioritize fixes and improvements. We agree with many of your ideas and are continuing to work hard to polish the game further.
More bug fixes and updates are coming very soon. Thank you for your support and for being part of the Ocean Keeper community.

First off, a huge thank you to everyone who’s joined us on this incredible journey since the official release of Ocean Keeper on Steam! We’ve seen an amazing response from players, and we truly appreciate all your support. We’ve also noticed some common questions and feedback across Steam and Discord, so we wanted to take a moment to address them here.

notes.title: 1. Why Did My Saves Disappear After the Release?

items.text: This has been the most asked question, and we totally understand the frustration. The reason your progress was reset is due to some key changes we made to the game. We’ve added a new storyline and locked many weapons and upgrades that will now unlock gradually as you progress through the story. Our aim was to provide a more organic gameplay experience where players explore and progress naturally, without feeling overpowered right from the start. Additionally, with all the new content we’ve added and some things we’ve removed, it was difficult to maintain saves in the previous format.

notes.title: 2. Why Is the Update Only Available on Steam? When Will It Be Available on Other Platforms?

items.text: We know many of you are eager to play Ocean Keeper on Xbox, PlayStation, mobile, and Steam Deck. The main priority for us was the full release on Steam, and we’re now focusing on bringing the game to Steam Deck first, including getting full verification from Steam that the game works seamlessly on it. After that, our next major focus will be fixing bugs and porting the updated version to other platforms like Xbox, PlayStation, and Nintendo Switch. Rest assured, we’re working as quickly as we can to make sure Ocean Keeper is available and polished across all platforms.

notes.title: 3. What About the Reward for Players Who Played Before the Release?

items.text: We know it can be disappointing to lose progress, especially after investing time in the game. As a thank you to those who played before the official release, we’re rolling out an update today that will reward you with a special bonus to help you progress faster in the game. Check out the details below for what you can expect!

Once again, thank you for your continued support and feedback. We’re reading everything and making improvements where we can. If we haven’t responded to you yet, don’t worry — we’re on it and will get back to everyone as soon as possible.
Stay tuned for more updates, and as always, happy adventuring!
— The Ocean Keeper Team
We're happy to release the 0.8.4 update, designed to improve your gaming experience by fixing critical bugs and addressing remaining issues. Here’s what’s been improved:
Wave Completion Bug Fixed: Corrected an issue where waves wouldn’t end due to stuck enemies, ensuring smoother progression through battles
Black Screen on Game Launch: Fixed a critical bug where disconnecting from the internet during launch caused a black screen and infinite loading.
We hope these adjustments make your gameplay smoother! As always, let us know if you encounter any more issues.
Update 0.8.3 brings key improvements to enemy tracking. Here’s what’s new:
Updated Enemy Indicator - We’ve revamped the look of the enemy indicator and improved its functionality to help you track threats more easily.
This hotfix focuses on resolving critical gameplay bugs. Here’s what’s been improved:
CarpetMissileLauncher Shoots Without Reloading: fixed a bug where after pumping meta-upgrade SkillReloadTime to maximum CarpetMissileLauncher worked without reloading.
No Destructible Objects: fixed the lack of destructible objects on the map.
This hotfix focuses on resolving critical gameplay bugs and includes a few visual tweaks. Here’s what’s been improved:
Digger Drill Stat Reset: Fixed an issue where upgraded drill stats would reset upon entering a new mine.
Missing Object Textures: Restored missing textures on some map objects.
AutoShotGun Targeting Issue: Resolved a bug where the AutoShotGun wouldn’t fire at enemies.
NapalmBombLauncher & JammingMissileLauncher Misfire: Fixed an issue where shots from these weapons would inaccurately fire beneath the mech instead of at enemies.
Updated Mine and Turret Models: Fresh new designs have been added to enhance the look of mines and turrets.
We hope these adjustments make your gameplay smoother! As always, let us know if you encounter any more issues.
New major update 0.8.0! In this update, you'll find exciting new gameplay improvements, features and content that will take your underwater adventures to the next level.

From all-new mechs and diggers to new enemies and iconic locations, there's plenty to explore and conquer. Whether you're diving into new challenges or upgrading your arsenal, this update promises deeper gameplay, more variety, and even more intense action.

This update introduces a completely redesigned mech system, bringing three different levels of mechs in depth. Each mech gets bigger and more powerful as you upgrade, visually transforming from compact blue to bold red. The more upgrades you buy in the hub, the more your mech evolves, visually demonstrating your progress and power.
Compact and efficient, the blue mech is your starter companion, perfect for your first dives into uncharted waters.
The yellow mech is more powerful and resilient, showing increasing strength as you explore later waves of enemies.
Real power. With its massive hull and imposing design, the red represents the progress of your journey.
Our Diggers have gotten a new and improved look, now offering three levels of visual upgrades. Each level emphasizes armor and power, ranging from a neat blue to a formidable red.
These Diggers will change in sync with your mech, complementing its atmosphere and declaring that you are fully prepared to conquer the depths.
Here every corner holds the mysteries of the past. In the laboratory you will find traces of long forgotten experiments. Be careful, for there are mysteries lurking here.
The underwater counterpart of the famous skyscraper, this mine is impressive in size. Make your way through its gloomy floors and solve all the mysteries hidden inside the skyscraper.
We’ve added destructible objects to make your Ocean Keeper experience even more immersive!

Now, much of the environment can be broken down – from small crates to massive structures like dinosaur bones – bringing your surroundings to life as they react to the chaos you unleash. Destructible environments add extra thrills, making each dive more dynamic.
This update introduces new visual effects that make gameplay even more enjoyable!
Now, when bullets hit enemies, you see impact effects that add to the satisfying experience of each hit.
Upon dying, enemies now shatter into shards that float to the surface, enhancing the atmosphere of combat.
In addition, the Worm and Stinger enemies now have unique new attack effects, making each encounter with them more visually dynamic.
We've also added new ore physics for a more realistic underwater feel – now, ore reacts naturally to its surroundings.
Additionally, the visuals for the focus arc have been reworked, giving it a refreshed and sharper look to better highlight key moments in combat.

Meet the new enemy: Puddle! This larger, black-colored blob brings a new hazard to the battlefield. Upon defeat, it explodes, leaving behind an acidic puddle that deals damage if you stand in it. Watch your step!
Napalm — Upon explosion, this chip leaves behind a fiery napalm pool that burns anything in its path.
Electro — Release a chain of electric shocks that paralyze enemies. With this mod, you can control groups of foes, stunning them and stopping their attacks.
Detonating — Prepare for a cascade of small explosions across the area. This chip spreads damage throughout the zone, eliminating everything in its wake.
Boss Body Movement After Death: Fixed a bug where the boss’s body continued to follow the mech’s movement after its defeat.
Artifact Tutorial Window in Main Menu: Resolved an issue where the relic tutorial window would remain on-screen after returning to the main menu until the game was restarted.
Missing Rock Collider: Repaired the missing collider on rocks, which allowed the mech to climb unintended surfaces.
Meta-Currency Counter Missing in Customization: Fixed a bug where the meta-currency counter was absent in the customization menu.
Floating Mine Launcher: Corrected an issue where mines launched from the Mine Launcher were appearing mid-air instead of on the ground.
Drone Doesn't Carry All Ore: Fixed an issue where the drone would only carry one ore and dump the second ore instead of carrying both.
Enemies Passing Through Objects: Fixed an issue where enemies could walk through certain objects due to missing NavMesh configurations.
UI Fixes in Session Upgrades Menu: Adjusted the size of the “Session Upgrades” title across all languages and repositioned the currency and ore counters.
Crab Boss Death Bug: Resolved an issue where, after defeating the crab boss, the wave wouldn’t end due to a looping animation bug.

Thank you all for your continued feedback and support. As always, your input is instrumental in helping us improve the game. Keep exploring, and don’t forget to leave a review or share your thoughts on Discord. Stay tuned for more updates, and we look forward to hearing your thoughts!
See you in the depths!
We’re rolling out a hotfix with several key bug fixes and optimizations aimed at improving gameplay and ensuring a smoother experience. Here’s what we’ve addressed:
Turrets Launcher Upgrade Name: Fixed the name of the upgrade to "Duration" for the turret's operational time.
Enemy Path to Statue of Liberty: Adjusted the spawn point for enemies to bring them closer to the Statue of Liberty, improving their approach timing.
Missing Missiles: Fixed an issue where missiles were not appearing on the Missile Launcher and Carpet Missile Launcher.
Explosive Ammo Lag: Resolved sound lag related to the use of explosive ammo.
Contrast Change on Low Settings: Corrected the issue where contrast levels changed when entering a session on low graphics settings.
Tutorial Buttons with Gamepad: Fixed the issue where incorrect keys were shown in the tutorial when a gamepad was connected but the keyboard was used.
Auto-Slots Button: Resolved the issue where the "Buy" button didn’t disappear after purchasing all auto slots.
Shield Pushes Worms: Fixed the bug that allowed shields to push both regular and boss worms.
Ore Drop Malfunction: Corrected an issue where dropping ore stopped working after pressing drop/pick buttons multiple times near the mine exit.
Game Doesn’t Start on Constant "Start" Press: Fixed a bug where the game wouldn’t start if the Start button or Enter key was pressed repeatedly.
Endless Loading Screen on Session Exit: Fixed the infinite loading screen when pressing ESC during a session exit.
Missile Launcher Through Objects: Missiles now no longer pass through rocks and objects.
Cargo Upgrade Malfunction: Fixed an issue where the cargo capacity upgrade only worked after dropping at least one ore.
Map Object Disappearance: Addressed the issue where map objects would disappear depending on the distance from the mech.
Turret Health Stats Removed: Turret health stats were removed as enemies now ignore turrets.
Enemy Optimization: Improved performance during large waves, ensuring smoother gameplay and reduced lag during combat-heavy moments.
We're always striving to enhance the experience and address any issues you report. Thank you for your continued feedback!
Dive in and enjoy the updates, and don't forget to share your thoughts with us in Discord or through a review on Steam. Happy exploring!

A major new 0.7.0 update is here, containing interesting new content and a number of critical fixes. This update improves gameplay, fixes key bugs, and makes balance adjustments to provide a more polished and immersive experience.

We’re constantly working to enhance the gameplay of Ocean Keeper, and this update brings exciting new elements to keep things fresh and engaging. One of the highlights is the addition of a new interactive mine, offering even deeper exploration. And there’s more to come! Expect future updates with additional mines and new weapon chips that will expand your tactical options.
Interactive Mine: Dive deeper into exploration with our new interactive mine, complete with fresh content and puzzles to keep you engaged.
Added new element highlighting in the tutorial
Added new animations for meta-upgrade Explosion Drill
Turrets Launcher now disappear when the player moves a certain distance away
This update introduces unique weapon chips for two types of guns, giving you more ways to handle your enemies:
Ricochet Buckshot – Each pellet ricochets off enemies, causing extra damage.
Frost Buckshot – Applies a freezing effect on hit, slowing down enemies.
Laser Shot Gun – Fires laser-based pellets, dealing precise damage.
Explosive Buckshot – Causes an explosion on impact, dealing area damage.
Shock Buckshot – Creates an electrical shockwave in the area upon hitting a target.
Mini Rockets – Fires a single rocket that splits into smaller rockets mid-flight, hitting multiple targets over a wider area.
Explosion Drill Meta-Upgrade: Rebalanced to improve gameplay and provide better scaling.
Ice Bullets Chip: Adjusted to increase efficiency and performance.
Turrets Launcher Range: Rebalanced to optimize turret shooting range.
Relic Tutorial: The relic tutorial will now trigger after completing the first tutorial mine, making it easier to follow the game's progression.
Boss Wave Reappearance: Resolved an issue where, due to the worm boss’s quick defeat, an additional wave featuring the same boss would appear.
Duplicate First Wave in Tutorial: Fixed a bug where, after completing the first wave, the game would incorrectly trigger it again.
Monk Fish Transparency Effect: Corrected a bug that caused Monk Fish to remain transparent throughout the entire battle.
Broken Timer: Fixed a bug where the purple timer would break after a boss killed the player, affecting subsequent sessions.
White Square on Button Icon: Eliminated a visual glitch where a white square appeared on the screen next to the ore-lifting button.
Purchasing Locked Digger Abilities: Fixed a bug that allowed players to purchase and equip locked digger abilities.
Fixed skill slots not functioning correctly.
Replaced the outdated ore block art with new, visually appealing designs.
Resolved an issue where enemy indicators failed to disappear after wave completion.
Adjusted the size of dialogue windows in the tutorial for better clarity.
Fixed navigation issues occurring after submitting bug reports.
Corrected an issue where turrets wouldn't shoot at worm enemies.
Fixed object positioning issues in the lava biome for a smoother experience.
Fixed disappearing objects that would vanish from players’ views unexpectedly.
Corrected enemy spawn points near the Statue of Liberty to avoid abnormal behavior.

Thank you all for your continued feedback and support. As always, your input is instrumental in helping us improve the game. Keep exploring, and don’t forget to leave a review or share your thoughts on Discord. Stay tuned for more updates, and we look forward to hearing your thoughts!
See you in the depths!

items.text: It's time for update 0.6.19, which fixes important bugs and adds exciting new features to improve your gameplay. Our team is hard at work fixing issues and introducing new content to keep Ocean Keeper evolving and exciting for you.

This update includes a number of new features and improvements. From an all-new interactive mine to powerful meta-enhancements, these additions will make your journey through the depths even more exciting. Get ready to explore new mechanics, improve your strategy, and enjoy a more polished gameplay experience with these latest features!
New Interactive Mine: Titanic Mine

The Titanic Mine is now available and will bring new content to the game. This interactive mine is full of puzzles and valuable resources. Players will have to traverse its depths using intuition to earn rewards and advance further.
Missile Particles

We've improved the visual effects of missiles by adding updated particle trails, making them more dynamic and visually enhanced during combat. The new effects make missile launches sharper and more impressive, increasing the intensity of battles.
New Enemy - Monk Fish

This deep-sea predator is not just another fish: it possesses the unique ability to turn invisible, sneaking through the shadows to catch you off guard. Its stealthy nature makes it a formidable foe, as it can strike when you least expect it.
Reload Time for Skills: New meta-upgrade for reducing skill cooldowns for both the mech and digger.
Save Resources Module: A new meta-upgrade that saves resources after a previous run.
Explosion Drill: A new meta-upgrade for faster excavation in caves.
Extra Life: A meta-upgrade granting an additional life.
End of Mine Rewards: Updated rewards upon completing the Statue of Liberty mine.
Fixed incorrect stat names in the customization menu.
Resolved an issue with an invisible collider blocking entry to the mine.
Fixed a bug where upgrading bombs in customization spent currency but did not apply the upgrade.
Auto-repair now functions correctly against enemies and bosses.
Addressed a bug where drones and the digger could collect resources through blocked areas.
Corrected worm movement when the mech is stationary.
Resolved text overlap for drone stats when selecting a relic.
Fixed the relic tutorial window not disappearing after death during the tutorial.
Corrected double-click bug allowing duplicate skill purchases for the digger.
Adjusted drone upgrade logic to limit the maximum number of drones.
Fixed audio stacking during large enemy encounters.
Worm Boss now correctly triggers mines upon movement.
Fixed the incorrect display of numbers after upgrading the drill in customization.
Updated the old mine background in the tutorial to match the new visuals.
Resolved an issue where the mech's head could be rotated in the session settings menu.
We hope these fixes and additions greatly improve your gaming experience. Continue to provide feedback on our Discord channel, and don't forget to leave your reviews on Steam!
We've listened to your feedback and worked hard to resolve these critical issues. Your gameplay experience is our top priority, and we hope these fixes make your time with Ocean Keeper even better.
Broken Mine Shaft: Fixed an issue where players were unable to dig into certain mine shafts.
Close Camera in Mine: Resolved a bug where the camera was too close in the mine, restoring the intended perspective.
Free Auto-Slot After Skill Purchase: Fixed a bug that allowed players to purchase an auto-slot without the required amount of meta-currency after buying a skill.
Worm Clipping into Rock Textures: Corrected the bug where the worm would move into and shoot from within rock textures.
Map Collider Adjustments: Improved and fixed colliders on several map locations.
Auto-Size in Dialogues: Adjusted auto-sizing in dialogues for better readability.
Timer Stops When Relic is Retrieved: Fixed a bug where the timer would stop if a relic was retrieved at the very beginning of a wave.
Controller Detection Issues: Resolved an issue where the game wouldn't detect the keyboard and mouse if a controller was connected.
Loading Screen Localization: The loading screen has been fully localized, providing a seamless experience for players in their preferred languages.
Сontinue to share your thoughts and experiences on our Discord channel and leave your reviews on Steam. Your support helps us make Ocean Keeper better with each update.
Thank you for being an essential part of our community. Dive deep, explore fearlessly, and keep the ocean safe!

We’re thrilled to bring you update 0.6.12, packed with exciting new content, features, and crucial bug fixes that elevate the Ocean Keeper experience to a whole new level. This update introduces a host of fresh gameplay elements, visual improvements, and optimizations, making your underwater adventure even more immersive and engaging.
Our team has been working hard to bring you a host of new features that not only enhance the overall quality of the game but also add new layers of excitement and challenge.

Achievements for Steam: We’ve integrated Steam achievements into Ocean Keeper! Now you can track your progress and strive to collect them all, adding a new layer of challenge and satisfaction to your gameplay.

Updated Location Design: The entire map has been revitalized with numerous points of interest, making exploration more engaging and the world feel more alive. Discover these new additions as you navigate the depths!

Interactive Mine: We've added a new interactive mine with a full visual update and intriguing puzzles. Successfully completing these challenges will reward you generously . Dive into the mine and find out what's hidden inside!
Updated Explosion Effect: We’ve refreshed the visual explosions effect, making them more impactful and visually satisfying.
Updated Laser Visuals: The appearance of the laser has been enhanced and polished, providing a sharper and more refined look during combat.
Environment Update: To immerse you in a more mysterious underwater world, we decided to diversify the seabed by adding new elements of the environment.
Crab Damage Issue: Fixed a bug where the boss crab didn’t deal damage if the mech was positioned underneath it.
Icon Order Correction: Corrected the order of the Duration Rage and Acceleration icons.
Drone Collection Issue: Resolved the issue where the drone failed to collect ore released by the digger.
Main Rocket Gun Range: Fixed a bug where the Main Rocket Gun’s projectiles didn’t reach the Fat Worm.
Missing Back Button Label: Resolved an issue where the "Back" label was missing on the button when English was selected.
Entering Mech After Death: Fixed a bug where players could enter the mech after dying in the mine.
Mech Entering Rocks: Corrected a bug where the mech could pass into rocks in certain locations.
Infinite Descent Post-Mech Death: Addressed an issue where the digger would endlessly descend after the mech's death in the mine.
Double-Click Purchases in Hub: Fixed a bug that allowed players to make unintended purchases in the hub by double-clicking.
Incorrect Duration Shield Icon Order: Fixed the order of the Duration Shield icons to display correctly.
Ricochet Bullet Description: Corrected the description of ricochet bullets in relics for the Ukrainian localization.
Traditional Chinese Localization Errors: Fixed issues where English words appeared in the traditional Chinese localization of session upgrades.
Mech Clipping into Map Edge: Resolved an issue where the mech could clip into rocks at the map’s edge.
SteamDeck Incorrect PC Buttons: Fixed a bug where PC buttons were incorrectly displayed on the SteamDeck.

This update brings a wealth of new content and enhancements, transforming the Ocean Keeper experience and laying the groundwork for even more exciting developments ahead. From fixing crucial bugs to adding new features like Steam achievements and an interactive, we’ve packed this update with everything needed to make your journey into the depths even more immersive and rewarding.

But we’re not stopping here! There’s so much more to come, and we can’t wait to share it with you. Your feedback continues to be invaluable as we refine and expand the game, so please keep it coming. Dive in, explore the new features, and let us know what you think.
P.S Perhaps you noticed something else we didn't mention? You'll see it in a new upcoming update very soon.

We're excited to announce the latest update for Ocean Keeper, bringing new content and crucial bug fixes to enhance your experience. Our team has been working diligently to address various issues and introduce new elements that will make your underwater adventures even more engaging. Here’s what’s new in version 0.6.10:
Digger Control Post-Death: Fixed an issue where players could still control the digger after it had died in the mine.
White Squares Near Buttons: Resolved a graphical glitch where white squares would appear near interface buttons.
Mech Clipping Into Textures: Corrected a bug in the lava biome where the mech could clip into environmental textures.
Explosive Bullets on Blobs: Fixed an issue where explosive bullets did not produce the intended effect when fired at blob enemies.
Crab Boss Claw Sinking: Resolved a bug where the Crab Boss’s claw would sink into the ground during an attack.
Boss Health Bar Missing: Fixed an issue where the boss's health bar did not display correctly during boss waves.
Tutorial Mine Entry: Addressed a bug in the tutorial that prevented players from entering the mine at the start.
Block Collider Persistence: Fixed an issue where the collider for a block did not disappear after the block was mined.
Incorrect Stat Calculation in Hub: Resolved a bug where the meta-upgrades' total stats were incorrectly calculated in the Hub.
Settings Menu Post-Bug Report: Fixed a bug where the settings menu remained open after closing the bug report window, allowing the game to continue.
Background Enhancements: Introduced new atmospheric background to enrich the visual experience within the mines.
New Ore Visuals: Added new types of ore with distinct appearances, adding variety to your resource-gathering.

In addition to these updates, we are pleased to announce that Ocean Keeper is now included in special Steam bundles along with other great games. These bundles offer a great opportunity to expand your game library.

Your feedback has been invaluable in helping us refine Ocean Keeper, and we are committed to continuously improving the game. As always, we encourage you to dive into the latest version and explore the new features while keeping an eye out for any issues that might arise.
Continue to share your feedback and report any bugs via our Discord channel. Your involvement helps us ensure that Ocean Keeper remains the best experience it can be.
Thank you for your continued support, and happy exploring! 🌊

New Ore Visuals: Added new types of ore with distinct appearances, adding variety to your resource-gathering.

items.text: We are thrilled to announce the release of update 0.6.9, which brings a host of improvements, optimizations, and crucial bug fixes to enhance your underwater adventure.
Special attention has been given to address issues faced by our MacOS users, ensuring a smoother and more immersive gameplay experience for everyone.

We've resolved a critical issue where the game would not run on Mac OS, displaying only a gray screen. This fix ensures that our Mac community can now enjoy a seamless and immersive gameplay experience. Your patience has been greatly appreciated, and we're excited to have this resolved.
Visual Shield Bug: Resolved an issue where effects on the ground disappeared under the shield dome.
Language Change in Tutorial: Fixed a bug where the tutorial window did not immediately translate when changing the language.
Bosses with Incomplete Health Bars: Corrected a bug where bosses would spawn with less than full health bars.
Trimmed Customization Tabs: Addressed an issue where the digger customization tabs were cut off.
SteamDeck Stick Navigation: Fixed a bug where users couldn't navigate back up in the settings menu using the stick on the SteamDeck.
Enemy Optimization: Improved enemy performance, reducing potential lag and ensuring a more fluid combat experience.
Upgrade Window Toggle: Added the ability to open and close the upgrade window with the "TAB" key for easier access and better user experience.
Improved Drone AI: Enhanced the AI for drones, making them more efficient and responsive in gathering resources and aiding in gameplay.
Your feedback has been invaluable in helping us identify and address these issues. We are committed to continuously improving Ocean Keeper and providing the best possible experience for our players.
Please continue to share your thoughts and experiences on our Discord channel and leave your reviews on Steam. Your support helps us make Ocean Keeper better with each update.
Thank you for being an essential part of our community. Dive deep, explore fearlessly, and keep the ocean safe!

We've been closely monitoring your feedback and working hard to improve the game based on your invaluable insights. We understand the importance of creating a balanced and enjoyable experience, and we're thrilled to announce a significant rebalance update.

We heard you loud and clear. The initial waves were a bit too challenging for many players, so we've toned them down. This adjustment is aimed at making the start of your journey smoother and more enjoyable, allowing new players to get acclimated to the game mechanics without feeling overwhelmed.

In the past, players experienced extreme fluctuations in enemy strength within the same wave, leading to unpredictable difficulty spikes. We've addressed this by smoothing out the difficulty, ensuring a more consistent and fair challenge across all waves. Now, each wave will have a more predictable and manageable progression.

To keep the gameplay engaging and dynamic, we've shortened the spawn intervals of mobs within waves. This means you'll face more consistent action, maintaining the intensity and excitement throughout your play sessions.

We've reworked the scaling of wave difficulty up to wave 30. The early game is now less punishing, giving you a better chance to build your strength. However, the final waves have been made a bit tougher and more intense, offering a satisfying climax to your adventure. You'll need to strategize and utilize your upgrades effectively to conquer these challenging final waves.

The Worm Boss was previously a point of frustration for many players. We've balanced its damage output, ensuring that both its ranged attacks and jumping attacks are fair and challenging. This change applies to all waves where the Worm Boss appears, making for a more balanced and enjoyable boss fight.

We've taken a close look at the prices of upgrades and made adjustments to better reflect their utility. This means that upgrades will now be priced more intuitively, offering better value for their impact on gameplay.

One of the issues we identified was that players were not able to access upgrades quickly enough. To address this, players will now have access to several upgrades after their first run. This change ensures that you can start customizing and improving your mech early on, enhancing your overall experience.

To keep the game exciting and rewarding, we've significantly reduced the grind for upgrades. Now, after almost every run, you'll have the opportunity to unlock a new upgrade. This change aims to maintain a steady progression and keep the gameplay fresh and engaging.

The balance changes introduced in this update are a hotfix addressing major issues. However, we consider this a work in progress. We will continue to fine-tune the game based on your feedback and further testing. Expect more comprehensive balancing changes in future updates, as we strive to create the best possible experience for you.

Your feedback has been instrumental in shaping these updates, and we’re committed to continuously improving the game. We appreciate your patience and support as we work through these changes. Please keep sharing your thoughts and suggestions — they truly make a difference.
We want to extend a special thank you to all our beta testers who have tirelessly reported bugs and provided invaluable feedback. Your contributions have been essential in getting us to this point.
Stay with us, explore the depths, and enjoy the improved Ocean Keeper experience! 🌊✨
We've listened to your feedback and worked hard to resolve these critical issues. Your gameplay experience is our top priority, and we hope these fixes make your time with Ocean Keeper even better.
Crab Boss Crash: Resolved an issue where the game would crash after defeating the Crab Boss.
Invisible Cursor with Gamepad: Fixed the bug where the mouse cursor would become invisible when a gamepad was connected.
UI Customization Error: Corrected a problem where the customization tabs for the digger sometimes displayed as "Guns Guns Guns".
Meta Progression Save: Ensured that players meta progression is now saved when exiting the game during a run, preventing any loss of progress.
Wave Counter: A wave counter has been added above the timer at the start of each wave, helping players keep track of their progress.
Thank you for your continued support. Keep the feedback coming and happy exploring!

Release of update 0.6.3 for Ocean Keeper. Our team has been hard at work addressing several critical issues to ensure a smoother and more enjoyable gameplay experience. Here's what you can expect in this update:
Game Crash After Boss Kill: Resolved an issue where the game would crash after defeating the Crab Boss.
UI Display Issues: Fixed a bug causing incorrect display of the Guns tab.
Crab Boss Slowdown Fix: Addressed a problem where slowdown effects from weapons and bullets would freeze the Crab Boss.
Startup Volume Adjustment: The game no longer launches at 100% volume; the default startup volume has been reduced to 70%.

We are constantly working on enhancing your experience. Stay connected with us through our Discord channel and Steam forums for the latest updates and to share your feedback. Your reviews and suggestions help us make Ocean Keeper the best it can be.
This update focuses on significant bug fixes and performance optimizations, ensuring a smoother and more stable gameplay experience. Here’s what’s included:
Settings Save: Fixed an issue where game settings were not being saved upon exiting.
Main Weapon Auto-Fire: Resolved a bug where main weapons took too long to turn when auto-firing.
Endless Wave: Fixed a bug where a wave without enemies would not end.
Drill Upgrade Persistence: Corrected an issue where session-based drill upgrades were retained across sessions.
Customization Tutorial: Fixed a bug where the tutorial window was skipped immediately upon clicking the screen.
Meta Currency Save: Fixed an issue where meta currency was not saved if the game was exited without using the main menu.
Firewall Crash: Resolved a bug where the game would crash when the internet was disconnected.
Crab Boss Spawn: Fixed an issue where the Crab Boss would get stuck on the map.
HP Display in Customization: Corrected a bug where the mech's HP was displayed incorrectly in the customization tab after an upgrade.
Sound Optimization: Improved sound management to reduce audio-related performance issues.
Mine Exit: Removed the lag that occurred when exiting the mine.
Enemy Initialization: Optimized enemy initialization to reduce game freezes.
Overall Performance: Significantly reduced game freezes.
MacOS Build: Added support for MacOS.
We are continually working to improve the game experience and appreciate all the feedback from our community. Dive in and explore the new fixes and features.

Game Freeze: Corrected an issue where the game would freeze if a lot of waves were completed.

Firewall Notification: Resolved a bug causing firewall notifications to appear inappropriately.
Crab Boss Lag: Addressed performance issues causing lag after defeating the Crab Boss.

Shield Sound: Fixed a bug where the shield sound would play at the start of a new session.

Gamepad Relic Selection: Addressed a problem where the third relic option couldn't be selected using a gamepad.

Cursor Visibility with Gamepad: Corrected an issue where the cursor remained visible when a gamepad was connected.
Bullet Obstruction: Fixed a bug where main weapon bullets would block laser actions.

UI Optimization: Discord and Steam icons in pop-ups no longer overlap text.
Screen Resolution Settings: Improved the user experience for adjusting screen resolution.

Hello Keepers,
It's time for the first Ocean Keeper update, where we'll tell you about the latest features currently in development.

In our ongoing quest to bring you the most thrilling combat experience, we're excited to announce a significant update focused on enhancing the diversity and functionality of your arsenal. Our latest overhaul introduces a slew of new weapons and major updates to your mech-mounted auto-guns, all designed to elevate your strategic options and battlefield efficacy.
🔫 Revamped Arsenal for Tactical Dominance
Rocket Launchers & Electro-guns: We're reworking these to offer more varied tactical uses, ensuring that you can tailor your approach to each battle.
Railguns: Expect more power and precision, turning each shot into a devastating delivery of justice against your foes.
Machine Guns & Shotguns: We're polishing these staples of any mech's arsenal for smoother handling and better responsiveness.
We'd also like to highlight the new weapons added in the latest patch:
Napalm Bomb Launcher: This beast fires three projectiles that create fiery pools, dealing continuous damage to any enemies that dare tread across them.
Sniper Rifle: This high-caliber weapon pierces through multiple enemies in a line, perfect for those who favor precision and power.

Jamming Missile Launcher: This sophisticated piece of artillery fires missiles that burst on impact, releasing an EMP-like pulse that slows all enemies within the area. It’s perfect for those critical moments when you need to halt an enemy advance and gain the upper hand.

Detonation Charges: This weapon transforms your mech into a mobile artillery unit. Firing a missile that splits into multiple smaller bombs upon impact, it blankets the battlefield with explosions. Each cluster bomb is designed to maximize area coverage, ensuring no enemy escapes unscathed.
🎯 Upgrade Your Tactics

These enhancements are not just about raw power; they're about giving you the tools to craft more intricate battle plans and enjoy a more dynamic fight. Whether you're laying down suppressive fire with our improved machine guns or using the new railgun to snipe targets from afar, the power is in your hands. Customize your mech's loadout to match your preferred combat style, and take advantage of these cutting-edge weapons to dictate the pace of battle.
Strategize and Customize Your Playstyle

We want you to feel the power at your fingertips, choosing weapons and skills that resonate with your personal gameplay style. With these updates, every player can find something that perfectly matches their strategy, whether you're about from a distance with Sniper Rifle, or diving straight into the fray with Napalm Bomb Launcher
🚀 What's Next?

As we edge closer to the DEMO, this weapons system overhaul is a critical part of our final polishing efforts. We're dedicated to delivering a robust and thrilling combat experience that will keep you engaged right from the start.

Prepare for deployment, Keepers. The battlefield awaits, and with these new tools at your disposal, you are equipped to conquer any challenge. These enhancements are just a glimpse of what we have in store for you.

Thank you for your interest and support during this exciting phase of development. Keep an eye on our updates as we gear up for the official launch. The future of Ocean Keeper is nearly upon us, and we are thrilled to have you join us on this journey.
